successCriteria.description: LeaveRequestQueryParams in src/shared/types/index.ts exposes an optional `employeeIds?: string[]` field and no other new field.
IEmployeeRepository declares `findByManagerId(managerId: string, client?: PoolClient): Promise<Employee[]>`.
PgEmployeeRepository.findByManagerId returns every employee whose manager_id equals the supplied managerId, mapped through the existing mapRow, and does not select or reference password_hash.
EmployeeService.getEmployeesByManagerId delegates to `this.repository.findByManagerId(managerId)` and returns its result unchanged.

constraints: Add only the single field `employeeIds?: string[]` to LeaveRequestQueryParams; do not add any other field to that interface.

findByManagerId must reuse the existing `mapRow` helper and the existing employee column list (id, employee_number, first_name, last_name, email, role, manager_id, department, hire_date, termination_date, employment_status).
Do not touch `password_hash` anywhere — the column does not exist yet and arrives with the Phase 2 migration.
Do not modify the Employee model or CreateEmployeeInput.
Do not add routes, controllers, or tests in this phase.

Database access must go through the repository layer (no-direct-db-outside-repository); findByManagerId takes an optional PoolClient as its last parameter and falls back to the shared pool when omitted.
outOfScope: Adding routes, controllers, or HTTP endpoints for the new read support.
Adding tests for the new type field, repository method, or service method.
Adding the `password_hash` column or any migration.
Adding validation or not-found semantics to getEmployeesByManagerId (empty result is a valid empty array).

entityInvariants.invariant: The Employee entity shape is unchanged; findByManagerId returns Employee instances whose managerId equals the queried managerId, preserving the existing field mapping (including managerId: string | null).
employeeIds is an optional array of employee id strings used to scope leave queries by employee; it is additive and does not alter existing query-param semantics.

interfaceConstraints.authRule: None at this layer; authorization is applied by the consuming service/controller in later phases.
interfaceConstraints.errorSemantics: Read-only; returns an empty array when no employees match (no throw for empty result).

interfaceConstraints.authRule: None at this layer; role-scoping/authorization is deferred to later phases.
interfaceConstraints.errorSemantics: Pure delegation to repository.findByManagerId; returns empty array for no matches, no not-found throw.

consistencyRequirements.requirement: findByManagerId must reuse the existing `mapRow` helper and the exact employee column list already used by findById/findByEmployeeNumber/findByEmail.
The Employee return type of findByManagerId/getEmployeesByManagerId must match the existing Employee interface (field names and types).
employeeIds must be added to the existing LeaveRequestQueryParams interface without disturbing the other fields.
The repository method signature must follow the existing optional-client-last pattern (client?: PoolClient) with fallback to the shared pool.

integrationPoints.why: employeeIds on LeaveRequestQueryParams is the role-scoping hook that leave findByQuery will honour in Phase 4.

integrationPoints.target: Manager team-view / time-off calendar surfaces (later phases)
integrationPoints.why: getEmployeesByManagerId provides the manager-listing read support those surfaces consume.
